nl: Commit only src/app.py and docs/change-4.md with the message 'Update app output to v5'. The change to src/util.py must stay uncommitted in the working tree.

setup.description: A Git repository service-4 with two commits and three uncommitted changes.
setup.bash:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
printf '%s' '# service-4
' > 'README.md'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v1'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 1
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v5'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 2
' > 'src/util.py'
mkdir -p 'docs' && printf '%s' 'Notes
' > 'docs/change-4.md'
setup.pwsh:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'README.md'), '# service-4
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v1'')
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 1
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v5'')
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 2
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'docs' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'docs/change-4.md'), 'Notes
')

forbidden.reason: the uncommitted change must be kept

oracle_program: git.commit "." message: "Update app output to v5" paths: ["src/app.py", "docs/change-4.md"]
reference_bash: git add src/app.py docs/change-4.md && git commit -qm 'Update app output to v5'
reference_pwsh: git add src/app.py docs/change-4.md; git commit -qm 'Update app output to v5'

negatives.script: git add -A && git commit -qm 'Update app output to v5'
